name: crosslg-unlearn-benchmark-enen-og-sm-3
description: Benchmark for evaluating machine unlearning methods on language models in English-to-English settings. Measures how effectively models forget specified data while retaining general utility by comparing model outputs before and after unlearning interventions. Useful for assessing privacy-preserving and data-removal techniques in NLP.
evaluation_method: unlearning success rate (measured via drop in exact match/accuracy on targeted items)
reputation: Specialized benchmark for unlearning research with limited mainstream adoption.
